description: Quote moving USDC between chains (Relay). amountRaw is what arrives on the destination. The response fromAmountRaw is the source spend to cap usdc_execute_bridge with.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

amountRaw.description: USDC to deliver on the destination, raw integer units

apiKey.description: GDEX API key for AES encryption

gasTopUp.description: Destination gas top-up; default on for EVM destinations, off for Solana. Its cost is in the estimate

gasTopUpAmountUsd.description: Gas top-up in USD, up to 50 (default 1)

name: usdc_estimate_bridge
